name: Napa Valley
about: Harvest season (Aug–Oct) is the most atmospheric — and busiest, priciest — spring brings mustard-flower blooms between the vines, winter is quiet and rainy.
overview: Rolling vineyard hills an hour from San Francisco, built entirely around wine, food, and slow afternoons.
costOverview: Wine tasting fees alone can rival a full day's food budget elsewhere — a walk-in tasting starts reasonable, but flagship Cabernet houses charge a real premium.

specialSeasons.text: Grape harvest (crush season) is underway, the most atmospheric and bustling time in wine country.
Wild mustard flowers bloom bright yellow between the vine rows.
